summary: Removals and renames you decide once on the managing tenant now reach every managed tenant.

new.title: Remove a row in managed tenants too
new.text: When you remove a replicated row, you can choose to remove it in the managed tenants as well. Each tenant removes it on its next pull, without separate approvals.

new.title: Renamed groups stay one group
new.text: Renaming a group now renames it in the managed tenants instead of creating a second group. A rename onto a name a tenant already uses is refused.

new.title: See and cancel before publishing
new.text: Every authorised removal or rename is listed on Pending changes with what, where and who decided it. You can cancel it before it is published.
